als_toggle.title: ALS: Toggle
als_toggle.onDown: if not controller.getController("alsAntiLag") then guihooks.message("This vehicle has no turbocharger, anti-lag is not available", 4, "ALS") return end electrics.values.alsEnabled = 1 - (electrics.values.alsEnabled or 0) guihooks.message('ALS ' .. (electrics.values.alsEnabled == 1 and 'enabled' or 'disabled'), 4, 'ALS')

als_scramble.title: ALS: Scramble boost
als_scramble.desc: Raises the boost limit for a temporary overboost
als_scramble.onDown: if not controller.getController("alsAntiLag") then return end electrics.values.alsScramble = 1 - (electrics.values.alsScramble or 0) guihooks.message('Scramble ' .. (electrics.values.alsScramble == 1 and 'enabled' or 'disabled'), 4, 'ALS')

als_rolling.title: ALS: Rolling anti-lag
als_rolling.desc: Hold to keep anti-lag active while rolling

als_launch.title: ALS: Rolling launch
als_launch.desc: Hold to pin the engine at the RPM it was at when the key was pressed, while anti-lag stays engaged
